offence_note: Customs Act false statement and evading duties on imported goods
sentence_quote: As a result, there will be a conditional discharge imposed. There will be a period of probation of nine months attached to it
note: Fines replaced by conditional discharge; surcharge $10,000 excluded from fine; study permit and English second language mitigating.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: Therefore, I sentence Mr. Glasgow to a period of two years in a Federal institution.
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived; forfeiture of $6,850 by consent.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is refused.
note: Appeal dismissed because appellant was unlawfully at large; sentence length and offences not stated.

offence_note: Sexual assault and uttering threats in domestic relationship
sentence_quote: For the sexual assault of S., I sentence you to imprisonment for 3½ years.
note: Threat count one year concurrent; SOIRA 20 years; weapons ban 10 years; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Second degree murder; parole ineligibility set
sentence_quote: For the second degree murder of Bradley McPherson, I sentence you to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole for 15 years.

offence_note: Assault by care worker on vulnerable resident
sentence_quote: Judge Whalen suspended the passing of sentence and placed Mr. LeBlanc on probation for 12 months with conditions. In addition, he was ordered to do 50 hours of community service work during the period of probation.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; discharge was refused as contrary to public interest.

offence_note: Possession of methamphetamine for trafficking; loaded restricted firearm without licence
sentence_quote: Count 2: I sentence you to 30 months' imprisonment for possession of a loaded restricted firearm, without a licence, contrary to s. 95(1) of the Code to be served concurrent to the sentence imposed on Count 1.
note: Count 1 six months concurrent; surcharge $400 excluded from fine.

offence_note: Heroin offence involving large amount; conviction after trial
sentence_quote: Accordingly, leave to appeal sentence is granted but the sentence appeal is also dismissed.
note: Sentence length and exact drug offence not stated; co-accused received different sentence.

offence_note: Break and enter with intent and robbery of elderly woman
sentence_quote: I cannot say, however, that the trial judge erred in law or principle in imposing the sentence that he did, and I cannot say the sentence is unfit.
note: Trial judge considered time in custody in setting six years; amount of credit not stated.

offence_note: Attempted armed robbery, masked, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal against the sentence of seven years and allow the appeal to the extent of deleting the order under s. 741.2 of the Code.
note: Seven years stands; only the delayed parole order was removed; concurrent two and three year terms.

offence_note: Two counts dangerous operation of motor vehicle causing injury
sentence_quote: Mr. Williams was sentenced to nine months to be served as a conditional sentence.
note: Conditions include counselling and house restriction; driving ban 21 months plus three-month administrative suspension.

offence_note: Robbery with knife of woman walking alone
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence, allow the appeal, and substitute a sentence of two years less a day in prison, followed by two years of probation.
note: Three years reduced; profound deafness made prison harsher; conditional sentence precluded.
